rapport_notes: Patient with a rambly, indecisive customer; answered a complex two-location pricing question twice without frustration.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before I do all that, is there any particular specific concerns or questions that you would like answered on this call besides price?" (asked before logistics probing)
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep fully priced out both of the customer's stated pod-location options (unload-and-deliver vs. pod-delivered-to-him) rather than dropping the topic after the first mention
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "I definitely think that you would fall within that range" tied to specific pod-fullness/box-count facts

top_strength: Patiently worked through a genuinely complex, indecisive customer's two different move-location scenarios and gave him clear pricing for both rather than forcing him toward one option.
coaching_note: Customer is torn between two move dates and hasn't committed — a stronger close (locking in one option, then holding silence) could have moved this from 'I'll let you know today' to a booked call.
